verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (logo, headline, subline, CTA), but every element is tiny and pushed to the left. The logo sits on its own axis (~x175), the CTA is indented away from the text's left edge (x83 vs x43), and the right half and bottom third are dead space. B fills the canvas better and centres the CTA under the brand, but the oversized SOLSTICE logo overpowers the small headline, which inverts the hierarchy. B also mixes left-aligned copy with a centred logo and CTA and leaves empty space beside the tiny headline and subline. Both are clearly flawed; B is marginally less empty.
